items.title: Emile Barnes and Paul Barnes Interview, 1959-10-01
items.q: the man who composed it, I don't know his name, but he used to call him the Mayor of Pompon.

ctx.x: And we had. Well by the way, who do you think wrote that? Where was the first time you ever heard that?

D.D. Well, I'll tell you the facts of the thing. There's nobody around New Orleans wrote that. The, the, the, as far as I can, the man who composed it, I don't know his name, but he used to call him the Mayor of Pompon. That's all he said, he was the Mayor of Pompon. Yeah. And he used to sing that A La Ba.
I think it came out in the Creole country, I don't know, that's right. Yeah, that's right.
